key_points: ETF inflows of $263M into Tesla and $215M into AMD indicate strong demand for large-cap components.
Significant purchases of Apple, Costco, Walmart, and Alphabet suggest continued investor confidence in core S&P 500 stocks.
AI sector risk noted but characterized as a higher hurdle rather than an extinction event, limiting downside.
Macro commentary mixes neutral to slightly positive cues, with no concrete negative triggers for SPY.
Overall net flow into many S&P 500 constituents supports a modest bullish bias over the coming weeks.
